title: 反应镜头测试
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu, plucked strings, tension, instrumental, no vocals
logline: Pacing test: lines continue over the listener's reaction shot, ~2.2 s per shot.

clips.summary: Under {loc}, {dahua} sneers at {xiaokang}; he answers that no honest investment pays that much, and she bristles.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: leaves rustling, a crowd murmuring.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李小康，你是属苍蝇的吗？哪儿有好事你就往哪儿叮！
cuts.say: 李小康，你是属苍蝇的吗？哪儿有好事……你就往哪儿叮！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre-left of the frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre-right of the frame, dappled sunlight.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} flinches slightly, jaw tightening, eyes fixed on her.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 银行定期才不到百分之三，哪有这么高的收益？
cuts.say: 银行定期才不到百分之三……哪有这么高的收益？

cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, centre-left of the frame.
cuts.action: {dahua}'s face twists with irritation; she folds her arms.
